# Abishek Hospital, Erode, Tamil Nadu: full summary

Abishek Hospital is a women's health and maternity hospital at Erode Fort, Tamil Nadu, India. This file collects the hospital's key facts and frequently asked questions in one place. Source: https://abishekhospital.com

## Key facts
- Name: Abishek Hospital (also written Abishek Medical Center), Erode, Tamil Nadu, India
- What it is: a women's health and maternity hospital (obstetrics and gynaecology). One hospital, at Erode Fort. There are no branches in other cities.
- Address: No.18, Near Bus Stand, Bharathi Street, Erode Fort, Erode - 638001, Tamil Nadu, India
- Doctor: Dr. Jayanthi Prabakaran, Consultant Obstetrician & Gynaecologist, Academic Topper from Coimbatore Medical College. Tamil Nadu Medical Council registration number 60813 (as supplied by the doctor). Over 40,000 safe deliveries.
- Outpatient clinic hours: Mon – Sat, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM. Emergency care: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 97505 11225. Email: info@abishekhospital.com
- Languages: Tamil and English. Tamil pages: https://abishekhospital.com/ta/
- Online consultation (audio or video call with the gynaecologist): Rs 499 for up to 15 minutes; the time slot is confirmed on WhatsApp based on the doctor's availability. https://abishekhospital.com/online-consultation/
- Reviews: 5.0 rating from 1,700+ Google reviews (as shown on the hospital's Google Business Profile, November 2026). See them at https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Abishek+Hospital+Erode+Fort+Tamil+Nadu
- Numbers published by the hospital: 40,000+ Safe deliveries; 2,500+ Epidural (painless) deliveries; 500+ IUI conceptions; 7,000+ Laparoscopic gynaecological surgeries.
- Official channels: website https://abishekhospital.com; YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@drjayanthiprabakaran (@drjayanthiprabakaran); Instagram https://www.instagram.com/abishekmedicalcenter; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/dr.jayanthi.prabakaran
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Abishek+Hospital+Erode+Fort+Tamil+Nadu

## Services
### Online Consultation
Talk to the gynaecologist from home by audio or video call. ₹499 for up to 15 minutes, with a slot based on the doctor’s availability.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/online-consultation/

### Maternity & Pregnancy Care
Antenatal checkups, delivery and postnatal care, with emergency care available 24/7.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/maternity-hospital-erode/

### Normal & Painless Delivery
Supported normal delivery with the option of epidural (painless) labour. Over 2,500 epidural deliveries.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/normal-painless-delivery-erode/

### Caesarean (C-Section) Delivery
When a caesarean is advised, what to expect during the operation and how to recover.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/caesarean-delivery-erode/

### High-Risk Pregnancy Care
Specialised, closely monitored care for complex pregnancies, with 24/7 monitoring.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/high-risk-pregnancy-erode/

### Postnatal Care
Recovery after normal or caesarean delivery, breastfeeding support, your mood and your postnatal checkup.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/postnatal-care-erode/

### Gynaecology & Women’s Health
Lady doctor consultations for periods, fibroids, cysts, discharge, pelvic pain, menopause and family planning.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/gynecologist-erode/

### Fibroids & Ovarian Cysts
Heavy periods, pelvic pain or pressure: tests and treatment options, including keyhole surgery when needed.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/fibroids-ovarian-cyst-treatment-erode/

### PCOS / PCOD Treatment
Diagnosis and management of PCOS, thyroid and other hormonal conditions.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/pcos-treatment-erode/

### Fertility & IUI Treatment
Fertility evaluation and IUI treatment, with over 500 conceptions through IUI.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/infertility-treatment-erode/

### Laparoscopic (Keyhole) Surgery
Minimally invasive gynaecological surgery. Over 7,000 laparoscopic surgeries performed.
Page: https://abishekhospital.com/laparoscopic-surgery-erode/

## Frequently asked questions
### Where is Abishek Hospital in Erode?
Abishek Hospital is at No.18, Near Bus Stand, Bharathi Street, Erode Fort, Erode – 638001, Tamil Nadu. See the map and directions .

### What are your clinic hours?
Mon – Sat, 9:00 AM – 6:30 PM. Emergency care is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

### Do I need an appointment?
You can book on WhatsApp or by phone at 97505 11225, or walk in during clinic hours.

### Is emergency care available 24/7?
Yes. Call 97505 11225 at any hour or come straight to the hospital. In a life-threatening emergency, dial 108 or 112 for an ambulance.

### How do I choose a gynecologist in Erode?
Look for a registered obstetrician and gynaecologist with the qualifications and experience for the care you need, a hospital with emergency and delivery facilities available at all hours, clear and upfront pricing, and a doctor you feel comfortable talking to. Dr. Jayanthi Prabakaran is an Academic Topper from Coimbatore Medical College with over 40,000 safe deliveries, and Abishek Hospital offers emergency care 24/7. You are welcome to visit and meet us before you decide.

### Do you offer online consultations?
Yes. Talk to Dr. Jayanthi Prabakaran by audio or video call for ₹499 per consultation of up to 15 minutes. We give you a slot based on the doctor’s availability, confirmed on WhatsApp. How online consultation works .

### How much is the consultation fee?
Consultation fees are kept affordable for all income groups, and treatment costs are explained clearly before any procedure. Please call or WhatsApp 97505 11225 for the current fee.

### When should I first see a doctor in pregnancy?
As soon as you have a positive pregnancy test, ideally in the first trimester. Read about antenatal care .

### Do you offer normal and painless delivery?
Yes. We support normal delivery, and epidural (painless) labour is available. Read about normal and painless delivery .

### What makes a pregnancy high-risk?
Conditions such as diabetes, high blood pressure, twins, previous caesarean or pregnancy loss, thyroid disease or age under 18 or over 35. Read about high-risk pregnancy care .

### Can I have a normal delivery after a caesarean?
Sometimes. It depends on your earlier surgery, your scar and your current pregnancy, and your doctor will assess you individually.

### Which doctor should I see for period problems?
A gynaecologist. Irregular, heavy, painful or missed periods are common reasons to visit. Read about gynaecology care .

### Is PCOS curable?
PCOS cannot be cured, but symptoms can be controlled very well with the right treatment and lifestyle changes. Read about PCOS treatment .

### What is the difference between PCOD and PCOS?
The names are often used for the same problem in everyday talk. Doctors use PCOS, and the care is tailored to your symptoms and goals.

### Do you offer menopause care and family planning?
Yes. We offer counselling and care for menopause and perimenopause, and personalised, affordable family planning and contraception advice.

### How long should we try before seeing a doctor?
Twelve months if the woman is under 35, and six months if she is 35 or older. Read about infertility treatment .

### What is IUI?
Intrauterine insemination places specially prepared sperm in the uterus around ovulation. It is short, simple and does not need anaesthesia.

### Does my husband also need tests?
Yes. A male factor contributes in about half of couples, and a semen analysis is a simple, painless first test.

### What is laparoscopic surgery?
Surgery through a few small cuts using a camera and fine instruments, with less pain, a shorter stay and faster recovery. Read about laparoscopic surgery .

### Can fibroids and ovarian cysts be treated by keyhole surgery?
Often yes, depending on their size, number and position. Your doctor will advise you after an ultrasound.

### I live in another town. Can I still visit Abishek Hospital?
Yes. Women come to us from Salem, Tiruppur, Namakkal, Karur, Coimbatore, Gobichettipalayam and other towns. Message us on WhatsApp or call 97505 11225 to book, and see how to reach us from your town .

### Do you have a branch in my city?
No. We have one hospital, at Erode Fort. We do not have branches in other cities.

### Is there a Tamil page?
Yes. தமிழில் படிக்க .

- [Namakkal](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/namakkal/): about 57 km from Erode Fort, about 1 to 1½ hours by road
- [Karur](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/karur/): about 65 km from Erode Fort, about 1½ hours by road
- [Coimbatore](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/coimbatore/): about 90 km from Erode Fort, about 2 hours by road
- [Gobichettipalayam](https://abishekhospital.com/womens-hospital-tamil-nadu/gobichettipalayam/): about 37 km from Erode Fort, about 1 hour by road

Health information on this website is general information, not a diagnosis or a substitute for an examination. In an emergency, go to the nearest hospital or call 108 / 112.
